name: Statistics for Management
description: Nature and role of statistics for management. Types of data, data measurement scales, Descriptive Statistics, Random variable and Probability distributions. Sampling Techniques, Hypothesis testing, Z-test, t-test, ANOVA, Chi-square tests, Correlation analysis, Regression analysis: simple and multiple regression. Business Forecasting. Use of softwares such as Excel, SPSS & R for statistical modeling.
